cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

mechanism: A keeps a confident helpful role by adapting to B needs while increasingly angry language reveals the personal cost of keeping everyone cooperative.
confusable: Distinguish passive-aggressive withdrawal from continued concrete help and encouragement as anger actually grows.
comparison: Paint damage forces revised cleanup under B feedback; birthday lunch changes force added spending under B wishes.
seedUse: Canonical paint and seaside lunch seeds supply rising cost and continued support; S02 should yield method or choice while preserving capable-helper confidence.
